Topology.name: db-connect
commands: for i in $(seq 1 30); do PGHOST='db' PGPORT='5432' PGUSER='postgres' PGPASSWORD='postgres' PGDATABASE='app' psql ${POSTGRES_URL:+"$POSTGRES_URL"} -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -c 'select 1;' && exit 0; sleep 2; done; exit 1

Topology.name: db-insert-users
commands: PGHOST='db' PGPORT='5432' PGUSER='postgres' PGPASSWORD='postgres' PGDATABASE='app' psql ${POSTGRES_URL:+"$POSTGRES_URL"} -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -c 'insert into users (email) values ('"'"'test@example.com'"'"');'
